summary: Implemented the rich_measure and VerticalCenter feature without running tests or committing, as instructed. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level counter decremented only on child-list exhaustion, indent of 4 per level). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, Align width constraint to measured maximum (min with explicit width), and a new VerticalCenter class with __repr__, a render method using console.size.height and newline-segment padding, and __rich_measure__ delegating to Measurement.get. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in collected render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as unreleased with an Added subheading for both entries and keeps the existing bullet. tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render, measure, no-attribute-error, and Align width tests. tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds the 11/19 tree measurement test and a single-node test. Verified by reading only: the expected 13-space string in the Align test and the tree arithmetic. Not verified by execution. Nothing committed.
